resources.string: Choose any displays below. A single key press moves to the next selected display, in this order. Music and charging take priority. With none selected, the background stays blank.
The interval restarts after a key press or when the background returns. Music, charging, and hidden backgrounds pause automatic changes.
This settings screen is unavailable on your device.
Allow access to show the Notifications toy.
Access granted. Counts stay on your phone.
Access granted. Waiting for the notification listener.

Shows the number of outstanding dismissible notifications, excluding ongoing services and media and avoiding duplicate group summaries. Apps do not provide a reliable unread-message count. Opening the notification shade alone does not clear the count. Notification contents are not stored or sent anywhere.
This style also applies when Notifications appears in Ambient.
The bell and full-size count each hold for 3 seconds, then slide left into the next view.

All styles show 0–9, then 9+ for ten or more notifications. A question mark means access or the listener is unavailable. Notification access is separate from permission for GlyphWorks to post its own notifications.
Optional: shows outstanding notifications on the Glyph display. Counts are local; notification contents are not stored or sent.
Optional · enable Weather and set up location access, including while locked.
Weather enabled. Approximate and background location granted.

Weather sends your approximate location to Open-Meteo to get current conditions and temperature. It refreshes while the Weather toy or an Ambient cycle with Weather is in use. Enable it below to use this service. Location and weather are cached privately on this phone.
To follow location changes while your phone is locked, open Permissions → Location and choose “Allow all the time”. Approximate location is enough.
Open app permissions to allow location all the time.
With location allowed only while using the app, locked weather uses the last location obtained while GlyphWorks was visible. Open the app after moving to update it.
Weather is off. Open settings to enable it.
Waiting for a location. Check that device Location is turned on.
Weather is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
Current weather is available. It refreshes about every 15 minutes while in use.
Showing cached weather while an update is unavailable. A dim dot marks older data; readings expire after two hours.

Weather is optional and sends approximate location to Open-Meteo. Set it up below: enable Weather, grant approximate location, then choose “Allow all the time” so weather follows you while the phone is locked. These controls are also in Settings → Initial setup → Weather & location.
